Implement and tune monitoring, alerting and observability so issues are detected early and noise is kept low. Apply and verify cloud security, backup/DR and cost-optimization best practices in customer environments. Technical Escalation & Incident Resolution Act as the final technical escalation point for complex infrastructure, network, security and application-level issues that L1 and L2 engineers cannot resolve. Take technical command of critical and high-severity incidents: drive troubleshooting, coordinate with DevOps, SA and Security specialists, and communicate clearly with the customer until resolution. Lead root cause analysis and blameless post-incident reviews, and carry the fixes through to runbooks, automation and monitoring changes. Spot recurring problems across customers and engineer them out. Mentorship & Knowledge Transfer Design and maintain the hands-on technical ramp-up program for new and junior CloudOps Engineers, and run it. Hold regular technical sessions, deep-dives and labs on AWS services, troubleshooting techniques, tooling and new technology. Help individual engineers build the skills they need to progress into DevOps Engineer, Solutions Architect or Data Engineer roles. Customer Technical Engagement Lead the technical content of customer calls, operational syncs, incident reviews and operational roadmap discussions. AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Professional, DevOps Engineer Professional, Security Specialty) or equivalent cloud/observability certifications. Prior experience mentoring engineers into DevOps, Solutions Architecture or Data Engineering disciplines.
